text: Every storm runs out of rain.
author: Maya Angelou

text: The sun is new each day.
author: Heraclitus

text: Into each life some rain must fall.
author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

text: Wherever you go, no matter what the weather, always bring your own sunshine.
author: Anthony J. D'Angelo

text: Bad weather always looks worse through a window.
author: Unknown

text: Rain is grace; rain is the sky descending.
author: John Updike

text: A rainy day is the perfect time for a walk.
author: Rachel Carson

text: There is no such thing as bad weather.
author: Alfred Wainwright
